import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

revision = '32f3e8ecf65426fc3306969496342d504bfa13f3'
model = str(Path.home() / '.cache/mmb_models/Qwen3.5-4B-MLX-4bit')
path = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo384_plan.json')
prior_path = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo192.json')
prior = json.loads(prior_path.read_text())
assert prior['status'] == 'completed' and len(prior['history']) == 192
checkpoint = Path('train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-rloo192/step_0192')
record = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {
    'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'one final fixed-budget doubling after the uncertain 192-group increment'}, revision),
    'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'status': 'registered', 'commands': [],
    'hypothesis': 'The 96-to-192 increment misses the registered real-improvement rule. Doubling once more distinguishes an insufficient update budget from diminishing returns on this dice-only reward.',
    'controls': 'Continue the exact RLOO192 adapter and Adam state to 384 cumulative groups; seed 5, lr 1e-6, four generations, same 600 shuffled dice train states and reward. No held-out score is inspected.',
    'initialization_sha256': {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in (prior_path, checkpoint / 'adapters.safetensors', checkpoint / 'optimizer.safetensors')},
    'observed_validation_evidence': {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in [Path('results/validation/qwen35-rloo192/cohorts.json'), Path('results/validation/qwen35-rloo192/vs_rloo96_14_contrasts.json')]},
    'validation': {'seed_start': 80000, 'episodes_per_game': 100, 'family_contrasts': 18, 'bootstrap_resamples': 72000, 'bootstrap_seed': 0},
    'real_improvement': 'Max-min selection-score gain >=5 points over RLOO192, one paired corrected lower bound >0, neither game corrected upper bound <0.',
    'stopping': 'If this also fails the real-improvement criterion, T23 and this trial are two consecutive nonimprovements. Diagnose the remaining gap, freeze the max-min winner across all seven local trials, and acquire its one raw-only 200/game test.',
    'selection': 'Same max min(dice percentage -80, cards percentage), earlier trial wins ties. One local candidate remains in the nine-candidate final family.'}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
result_path = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo384.json')
if not result_path.exists():
    shutil.copytree(checkpoint, Path('train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-rloo384/step_0192'))
    shutil.copyfile(prior_path, result_path)
assert json.loads(result_path.read_text())['history'][:192] == prior['history']
commands = [
    ['bash', 'scripts/with_resource.sh', 'heavy-ml', '.venv/bin/python', '-u', 'train/with_memory_guard.py', '--result', 'results/training/qwen35_rloo384_memory.json', '.venv/bin/python', '-u', 'train/mlx_rloo.py', '--model', model, '--revision', revision, '--adapter', 'train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft', '--out', 'train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-rloo384', '--result', str(result_path), '--steps', '384', '--seed', '5'],
    ['bash', 'scripts/with_resource.sh', 'heavy-ml', '.venv/bin/python', '-u', 'train/mlx_evaluate.py', '--model', model, '--revision', revision, '--adapter', 'train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-rloo384', '--label', 'qwen3.5-4b-rloo384', '--seed', '80000', '--episodes', '100', '--out', 'results/validation/qwen35-rloo384'],
    ['.venv/bin/python', 'scripts/retain_local_validation.py', 'rloo384'],
    ['.venv/bin/python', 'scripts/compare_local_validation.py', 'rloo384'],
    ['.venv/bin/python', 'scripts/compare_local_validation.py', 'rloo384', '--baseline', 'rloo192']]
try:
    for command in commands:
        record.update(status='running', current_command=command)
        record['commands'].append(command)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
        started = time.monotonic()
        subprocess.run(command, check=True)
        record.setdefault('completed_commands', []).append({'command': command, 'wall_seconds': time.monotonic() - started})
    record['status'] = 'validation_completed_before_selection'
except Exception as exc:
    record.update(status='failed', error=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
    raise
finally:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
hypothesis: The 96-to-192 increment misses the registered real-improvement rule. Doubling once more distinguishes an insufficient update budget from diminishing returns on this dice-only reward.
controls: Continue the exact RLOO192 adapter and Adam state to 384 cumulative groups; seed 5, lr 1e-6, four generations, same 600 shuffled dice train states and reward. No held-out score is inspected.
real_improvement: Max-min selection-score gain >=5 points over RLOO192, one paired corrected lower bound >0, neither game corrected upper bound <0.
stopping: If this also fails the real-improvement criterion, T23 and this trial are two consecutive nonimprovements. Diagnose the remaining gap, freeze the max-min winner across all seven local trials, and acquire its one raw-only 200/game test.
selection: Same max min(dice percentage -80, cards percentage), earlier trial wins ties. One local candidate remains in the nine-candidate final family.
